items.claim: Tobias relies on being bigger, stronger, and faster than his opponents to mug them with physicality, get on top, and submit them.
items.quote: Tobias to me is somebody who, when you look at the guys that he's fought, how he beats the guys, it's just somebody who is bigger, stronger, faster than the guys that he's fighting, and just kind of mugs them with his physicality, gets on top, and submits him, and wins the fight.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando throws very straight punches right down the middle, including straight one-twos, straight jabs, and straight crosses.
items.quote: One thing that stands out to me when I watch Lucas Fernando fight is just how straight these punches are, right? ... Everything's coming right down the middle. Straight one-two, straight jab, straight cross.

items.claim: Tobias shoots his takedowns from far away, such as 20 feet or a car length away.
items.quote: The type of shots he was taking to get these takedowns, it was eye-roll stuff. Like, what are you doing? Guy's shooting from 20 ft away. Like, the guy is shooting from a car length away.

items.claim: Neil Magny tends to finish opponents late in the fight after they gas out.
items.quote: The only way Neil Magny's beating these guys recently is just they just gas out and then he ends up he ends up finishing them somehow late in the fight.

items.claim: Neil Magny is a taller, longer striker with more tools and better kicks.
items.quote: Maybe. Maybe. Yeah, he's a taller, he's longer, he's got more tools, he's got better kicks.

items.claim: Neil Magny has a slight, tall frame and could not make 185 pounds naturally.
items.quote: Neil Magny does not have that. Neil Magny couldn't make 180. Excuse me, 185. If Neil Magny was making 185, it was because he was carrying two 10-lb dumbbells in his hands. That's just the kind of frame that he's got. He's a slight man. He's a tall man, but he's slight.

items.claim: Ramiz Brahimaj will be significantly stronger than Neil Magny in the clinch.
items.quote: I think in the clinch Ramiz Brahimaj is going to be way stronger.

items.claim: Ramiz Brahimaj has a stark jiu-jitsu advantage over Neil Magny and can find a front choke or take his back.
items.quote: I think that the jiu-jitsu difference between these two is pretty stark. I think that Ramiz Brahimaj should be able to find one of those front chokes or get to this guy's back and do it in round one.
